reconciliation_note: Revenue minus Cost of Sales equals Gross Profit and Profit Before Tax minus Income Tax equals Net Profit, to the unit, for FY2023 and FY2022 (16,811 - 13,586 = 3,225 and (43,286) - 484 = (43,770); 82,624 - 59,595 = 23,029 and (11,729) - 39,137 = (50,866), KSh thousands). Gross Profit minus Operating Expenses does not equal the operating result on this statement because the issuer strikes it through Other Income, Impairment of Assets and Finance Costs. Operating Profit (EBIT) carries the cash flow statement line Operating loss before working capital changes, the same convention used for FY2021 and FY2020 in this file. Net Margin and Operating Margin for FY2023 are withheld: the loss exceeds revenue by more than the 100 percent plausibility bound, so the ratio is omitted rather than printed.
